name: How do professionals fix a ceiling leak and dry out the area?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals fix a ceiling leak and dry out the area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals begin by identifying and stopping the water source. They then assess the extent of the damage using moisture meters. Water extraction is performed using specialized equipment, followed by structural drying with industrial-grade dehumidifiers and air movers. Affected materials, like drywall or insulation, are removed if necessary. The process aims to thoroughly dry all surfaces to prevent mold and further deterioration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals stop the leak, extract water, and use specialized equipment to thoroughly dry the affected area to prevent mold.
